name: VideoWhisper Cashtag Links
author: videowhisper

sections.description:
VideoWhisper Cashtag Links turns eligible financial cashtags such as $AAPL and $MSFT in enabled singular content types into direct research links. Select Yahoo Finance, Stocktwits, Finviz, Seeking Alpha, or X search; configure a custom HTTPS destination; add symbol-specific mappings; and optionally let readers choose another enabled destination.

Automatic linking is disabled until an administrator enables it. Original post content is never changed. The plugin does not fetch quotes, maintain a market-data catalog, require an account, or make a background request to a financial provider.

Cashtags are not universal instrument identifiers. The default matcher is deliberately conservative and does not validate a ticker. For mixed technical and investing content, use strict registry-only mode and configure the symbols you cover.

External services

The plugin itself sends no visitor data to an external service. When a visitor clicks an enabled research link, their browser navigates directly to the selected provider. Site owners choose which providers to enable.

  • Yahoo Finance: https://finance.yahoo.com/ — https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/otos/index.html and https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/privacy/index.html
  • Stocktwits: https://stocktwits.com/ — https://stocktwits.com/terms and https://stocktwits.com/privacy
  • Finviz: https://finviz.com/ — https://finviz.com/terms.ashx and https://finviz.com/privacy.ashx
  • Seeking Alpha: https://seekingalpha.com/ — https://seekingalpha.com/page/terms-of-use and https://seekingalpha.com/page/privacy_policy
  • X search: https://x.com/ — https://x.com/tos and https://x.com/privacy

These are third-party research/discussion destinations, not investment advice. Availability, account requirements, regional restrictions, and provider content are controlled by each provider.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install its ZIP from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate VideoWhisper Cashtag Links.
  3. Open Settings > Cashtag Links, choose at least one destination, select the content types, and enable automatic linking when ready.

Use [vw_cashtag symbol="AAPL"] to add one explicit link. Use [vw_cashtag_list] in a post or page to list symbols detected from that article’s saved content.

Posts and pages are selected by default. Public custom post types can be selected in Settings > Cashtag Links. Market suffixes such as $VVSM.DE and $IQE.L are recognized by default. Lower-case cashtags and numeric market symbols such as $9988.HK are opt-in matching formats because they have a higher false-positive risk. You can also append the symbol list after eligible article content in the settings.
sections.faq:
Are existing posts changed?

No. Links are added only to rendered content and disappear when the plugin is disabled or removed.

Does the plugin provide market prices?

No. It creates direct links only. It does not call a quote API or display market data.

How do I avoid false positives?

Use the ignored-symbol list, per-post disable control, vwcl-ignore CSS class or data-vwcl-ignore attribute, or strict registry-only mode.

Can I use international shares or crypto?

Configure an explicit registry mapping or use the shortcode. The automatic matcher intentionally does not guess an exchange, coin ID, or provider symbol.
